Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a work group to study services and programs for children.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a work group on the regulation of services andprograms for children; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that quality servicesand programs for children should be accessible to families livingthroughout the state. In order to ensure quality and accessibility,services and programs should be regulated in a fair and equitablemanner. Such regulation should be based upon the type of servicesprovided and the population of children served rather than on theparticular individual or entity that is offering the program.

The department of social and health servicesshall establish a work group to study the regulation of services andprograms for children provided by licensed child care providers and theregulation of afterschool and summer services and programs provided bylocal governments across the state. (1) The work group shall: (a) Determine whether or not there is an inequity in the regulation p. 1 HB 1391of services and programs for children provided by licensed child careproviders and the regulation of afterschool and summer services andprograms provided by local governments; and (b) Identify strategies for addressing any inequities in theregulation of services and programs for children that ensure access toservices and programs for children while maintaining the quality ofthose services and programs. (2) Membership of the work group shall include the following: Arepresentative of the division of child care and early learning of thedepartment of social and health services, a family home child careprovider, a child care center provider, a representative of theassociation of Washington cities, and a representative of theWashington state association of counties. (3) The work group shall report to the governor and the appropriatecommittees of the legislature by January 1, 2006, on the results of itswork.
